📷 Import from Screenshot (via Claude)
How it works: Paste your screenshot into a Claude chat (claude.ai), ask it to extract the data as JSON, then paste the result below. Takes about 30 seconds.
Privacy check: Crop screenshots to the minimum needed and remove phone numbers, email addresses, access codes, credentials, and unrelated resident details. Use only an account approved for work data.
Step 1 — Take a screenshot of your EliseAI calendar, move list, or Excel sheet.
Step 2 — Paste it into claude.ai and send this message:

Step 3 — Paste Claude's JSON response in the box below and click Import.
📄 Import from CSV / Excel

Export from EliseAI or save your Excel sheet as CSV (File → Save As → CSV). New records are added, existing ones are matched by unit+date and updated — no duplicates.

📄 CSV Format Guide
Tours CSV columns (any order):
name, date, time, unit, type (sgt/guided), contact, notes
Moves CSV columns:
unit, resident, date, type (in/out), time, total, elevator (yes/no), notes
Amenity Bookings CSV columns:
resident, unit, space, date, start, end, type (reservation/event), fee, notes
WiFi / Zentro Service CSV columns:
Unit, Name, Service End — upload Zentro's export as-is. Matches units already in Unit Tracker and updates their WiFi expiry (drives the Dashboard's WiFi Renewals banner); "N/A" clears the expiry. Units not yet in Unit Tracker are added.
Tip: Column names are flexible — the importer matches common variations (e.g. "Prospect Name", "prospect_name", "Name" all map to name).

WiFi renewal lookahead
Flag a unit this many days before its WiFi expires.

WiFi renewal grace period
Keep chasing an expired WiFi date for this long. Past it the unit drops off the alert and is listed as old data to clean up, so the alert can reach zero.
days
Auto-close old amenity bookings
A past booking with no close-out note is stamped “Auto-closed — no close-out was recorded” after this long, so ancient bookings stop inflating the count.

Recurring Reminders

Tasks that reappear on a schedule instead of getting archived once — physical inventory counts, cleaning checks, anything periodic. Shows on the Dashboard when due.

Card & Key Pools
Starting Counts

How many of each physical card/key you actually have. Leave blank if you haven't counted yet — "Reconcile" logs a physical count against what the dashboard expects, so drift gets caught early instead of surprising you months later.

One-Time Key Scan PIN

One shared PIN for the front-desk Key Scan QR code — anyone on the team can use it to log or return a one-time key from their phone without a full account login. Share it verbally with new hires on day one.

📧 Import from Welcome Letter

Paste the leasing “Welcome to Chorus” email below. I'll pull out the unit, lease start date, and move-in total and start a new move-in for you to confirm. Even just the subject line works. Include the resident's email and I'll guess the name too.

🔍 Reconcile with Master List

Copy your move-in Master List straight from Excel (or paste CSV) and drop it here. I'll match it against your dashboard move-ins by unit and flag anything missing, date-mismatched, or extra.
